description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents...“Stella Maris”, your dream getaway in Seagrove Beach. Picture yourself unwinding by your private pool, lounging under the stars, and soaking in the peace of a spacious corner lot with ultimate privacy. Feel the ocean breeze as you bike to the beach (just 3 minutes!) on one of the 6 included bikes. Perfect for families or friends, this retreat offers room to connect, relax, and create unforgettable memories. Learn more below...👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Private Pool – Indulge in ultimate relaxation with your very own private oasis, perfect for unwinding after a long day.3-Minute Bike Ride to the Beach – Feel the ocean breeze as you cruise to the nearby public beach access, with 6 bikes included for effortless exploration.Spacious Corner Lot with a Backyard Oasis – Enjoy a peaceful retreat surrounded by lush landscaping, multiple patios, and space to gather or simply relax in serenity.Dining for 8 Plus Bar Seating for 4 – Host memorable meals with family and friends in a space designed for togetherness and laughter.Quiet Seagrove Beach Community – Experience the charm of a tranquil coastal neighborhood, just moments from local dining, boutique shopping, and sandy shores.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐ "The house was absolutely perfect for our family vacation! It was spacious, beautifully maintained, and exactly as advertised. The pool was a huge hit with the kids, and being so close to the beach made our stay even better!" – Madison S.⭐ "This home is stunning, with a private backyard oasis that exceeded our expectations. The pool was incredibly relaxing, and we loved using the bikes to cruise to the nearby beach. A dream getaway!" – Leslie M.⭐ "Spacious, comfortable, and perfect for families. The pool was a highlight, and the house had everything we could possibly need for a fantastic vacation!" – Brian H.*** LIVING AREA ***Unwind in the spacious, light-filled living area, thoughtfully designed for both comfort and connection. The 2nd floor main living space boasts luxurious, plush seating and expansive windows that flood the room with warm natural light, creating an inviting atmosphere. Step outside onto the adjoining patios, perfect for relaxing under the open sky or enjoying meals in a serene outdoor setting. For added convenience, the 1st floor features an additional living area, offering extra space for lounging or accommodating guests. Every detail is crafted to elevate your lounging and dining experience.Inviting living room featuring plush, comfortable sofas and a sleek flat-screen TV for ultimate relaxationElegant sliding doors open to a covered patio with stylish dining and seating options, perfect for outdoor gatheringsFlooded with natural light and adorned with sophisticated coastal decor for a serene, breezy ambiance*** KITCHEN & DINING ***The fully equipped kitchen is a chef’s paradise, featuring state-of-the-art appliances, expansive countertops, and a sleek, modern design. Whether you’re whipping up a cozy breakfast for two or hosting an elegant dinner for 10, this kitchen delivers both style and functionality, making every culinary creation a delight.Spacious open kitchen featuring sleek stainless steel appliances and plenty of counter space for meal prepElegant dining table with seating for 8—ideal for family gatherings and special occasionsConvenient additional bar seating for 4, perfect for casual meals or entertainingCozy dining table for 3 located on the 1st floor, nestled beside the inviting living area*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Stella Maris is an outdoor oasis that truly stands out. Dive into the pool for a refreshing swim or soak up the sun on poolside loungers. The expansive backyard offers ample space for lively gatherings, complete with a high-end barbecue grill for cooking up a feast. Multiple patios and cozy lounging nooks create the perfect setting to unwind in style, while the front porch features additional seating with coffee tables for a relaxed morning or evening. Whether you're hosting or simply enjoying the peace, this home delivers an unparalleled outdoor experience.Luxurious private pool surrounded by plush, comfortable loungers for ultimate relaxationSpacious covered patio featuring elegant dining and cozy seating areas, perfect for alfresco meals and entertainment, complete with a high-end barbecue grill for outdoor cooking enthusiastsStunning second-story balcony with premium outdoor seating, ideal for savoring sunrise coffee or sipping sunset cocktails.Impeccably landscaped grounds designed to provide enhanced privacy and a serene escape*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Experience the perfect blend of comfort and elegance with our spacious, beautifully designed bedrooms, crafted for ultimate relaxation. Complemented by modern, fully equipped bathrooms, your stay promises to be a seamless mix of luxury and convenience.1st Floor:Queen Guest Suite: Queen Bed, flat-screen TV and easy access to a shared bathroomTwin Bunk Nook: Fun and functional Bunk Nook featuring Twin-over-Twin bunk beds, perfect for kids or extra guests2nd Floor:Primary King Suite: Luxurious King Bed, private en-suite with a deep soaking tub, rejuvenating rain shower and elegant dual sinks for ultimate comfort and styleQueen Guest Suite: Cozy Queen Bed, conveniently shares a spacious, well-appointed hall bathTwin Guest Suite: Charming setup with 2 Twin Beds, sharing access to the beautifully designed hall bath*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in the tranquil and luxurious Seagrove Beach, Stella Maris offers the perfect escape into the heart of 30A’s charm. Discover scenic trails, breathtaking state parks, and unique boutique shopping just moments away. Savor the flavors of the area with local dining gems like Café Thirty-A and Market Café, and experience the best of coastal living in style and comfort.Seagrove Beach East: A serene stretch of sand just steps away, perfect for a peaceful stroll or soaking up the sun.Old Florida Fish House: Experience the freshest seafood and stunning waterfront views at this renowned local favorite.Surfing Deer: Savor the local flavors and laid-back coastal vibe at this beloved dining spot.Seaside: A vibrant, picture-perfect beach town with charming streets, unique shops, and a lively atmosphere.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included but can be purchased separately.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Waiver required to get access to the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 47490STRO #: STR-047490
